intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. My flagship applications built on one shared House Frontend design system are OpenRO v1.6.0 (single-binary Rust Studio Copilot 3-pane Roblox Studio AI IDE with 19.05 MB RSS -83.5%, 113.7ms cold boot, Unified Pre-Publish Revenue & Playtest Gate + Auto-Fix cards, +Δ pts Autopilot score deltas, 17 pre-gzipped UI chunks, OpenRoCompanion.lua Studio plugin, all 13 official MCP tools, and Rojo .zip export at 5,610 req/s), OpenBell v0.9.0 (Institutional Quant Terminal for Kalshi Trade API v2 with 1-click Full Quant Edge Audit 5-stage Go/No-Go funnel, causal lookahead-canary tests, fail-closed Hard Risk Rails disarmed on every boot, Emergency Kill Switch, Out-of-Sample Strategy Tournament, PAV Isotonic Calibration, and $500/Day Capital Scaling Engine), and Fleet v1.2.0 (Antigravity-native Swarm Sidebar Plugin with 1-click Unstick/Resume triage presets, Open File in Aux Pane, Worker Context & Token Pressure saturation bars, zero-alloc Buffer.indexOf JSONL tailing & fingerprint cache giving 60.1ms boot, 122.2 MB RSS, 1,797 req/s, and 22/22 cold fuzz; legacy standalone Rust v0.12.0 preserved in git), alongside Ergon v0.16.0 (single-binary Rust Claude-Desktop employee desk with 11.74 MB fat-LTO binary, 27.6 MB RSS -18.9% via zero-DOM Audit Bundle streaming, clickable [file:L##] Source Inspector & Citation Verification, Promote to Playbook, Pre-Flight Check, Save as routine, SHA-256 Client Pack .md, and 6,188 req/s).
